execution_caps.manager_container_limit: external launcher authority; this CLI enforces aggregate parent+workers Q RSS

error: JointBudgetExceeded: RSS allocation exhausted (conservative sum includes shared pages)
recovery: immutable completed scalar QWork items retained; rerun identical --output with --resume and a new --report; original wall deadline and pre-action admissions remain charged

budget.accounting: q live cap; cumulative allocation/mapped-write/action costs never credited back; measured unlinks only; header/reservation slack retained; logical writes, not physical device I/O
budget.memory_accounting: parent plus child RSS; shared pages conservatively counted repeatedly
budget.time_cap: parent watchdog at 0.1 second intervals; native calls may be terminated
budget.action_accounting: durable pre-action admissions; killed/incomplete actions stay charged
budget.historical_worker_costs: original immutable QWork/transition receipts, not current execution
